assay: Lexogen QuantSeq 3' mRNA-seq, vastus lateralis, women
primary_estimand: Change in skeletal-muscle gene expression from pre-surgery to 9 months after RYGB in women randomized to RYGB + combined aerobic/resistance exercise training (RYGB+ET), compared with RYGB alone (standard of care); lean women as a baseline reference
sample_inclusion: GEO: 6 RYGB (pre/post9), 6 RYGB+ET (pre/post9), 6 lean controls (baseline only); 3-month biopsies mentioned in abstract are not in GEO
repeated_measure_unit: patient (pre and post9 biopsies from the same woman)
planned_contrasts: RYGB+ET POST9 vs PRE, paired (abstract: 'candidates modulated by exercise training'; GEO summary: transcriptome changes explaining RYGB+ET improvement; DEG count not in abstract)
RYGB POST9 vs PRE, paired (surgery alone)
exercise-specific: change in RYGB+ET minus change in RYGB (randomized comparison; not stated as a DE contrast in the abstract)
POST9 groups vs lean controls (GEO summary: 'restored to a lean phenotype')

paper_threshold.source_locator: abstract does not give a DEG threshold; full text unavailable

paper_method: DESeq2 V1.18.1 (GEO data_processing); JMP Genomics ANOVA also listed
paper_results: Abstract names TGF-beta1/SMAD2/3 pathway and follistatin (FST) as exercise-modulated candidates; ECM remodeling (collagen I) reduced more with RYGB+ET. No DEG counts in abstract.
